title: Estudantes & Trainees
SPARK Trainee- Portugal
description:
Job Purpose

The SPARK Programme is a dynamic, paid traineeship designed to give candidates hands-on experience in the fast-paced biotech industry. Over 2 to 12 months, you’ll gain real exposure to MoonLake’s mission, work alongside experienced professionals, and grow in an international, purpose-driven environment. To learn more about the SPARK experience and explore our programme in detail, click HERE.

Your profile

We are currently seeking SPARK trainees in the following areas:

• HR, People & Culture
• IT
• Industrial Engineering and Management
• Data Analytics
• Legal
• Medical & Drug Safety 
• Quality & PMO 

Key Accountabilities

• Contribute to real, high-impact projects across scientific, operational, or strategic teams
• Participate in onboarding and skills workshops tailored to your development
• Collaborate cross-functionally with teams in your hub and beyond
• Receive guidance from a dedicated mentor, including mid-program and final performance reviews
• Engage in the SPARKLAB macro project 
• Actively participate in team life, including a potential visit to another hub

Your profile

• Accepted at an institution for higher education, currently enrolled in or recently completed a higher education degree
• Curious, motivated, and eager to grow in a biotech setting
• B2 level of English or higher (written and spoken)
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Able to work in person at one of our offices at least 3 days/week

Work Location

• 3 days/week in our Zug (Switzerland), Cambridge (UK) or Porto (Portugal) office.

Why us?

An Exciting Opportunity Awaits you! 

MoonLake is a dynamic and innovative company pushing the boundaries of possibility, and we are looking for passionate individuals to join our stellar team.

What We Offer

• Learning Environment: An opportunity to learn and grow alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and innovative biotech environment.
• Impactful work: Contribute to ground-breaking projects that have the potential to transform global healthcare.
• Flexibility and Balance: Work remotely/hybrid, enjoying a healthy work-life balance while making meaningful contributions to our team.

Our Core Values

We look for potential MoonLakers that embody our three core values that drive our pursuit of excellence.

• We do Stellar Science: We aspire to create novel therapies that elevate treatment horizons, with innovative science, and high quality, always.
• We go beyond: We aspire to be positively disruptive in our field, and bold in the way we challenge the norms and each other.
• We unlock value: We aspire to create long-term value for investors and communities.

About Us

MoonLake Immunotherapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company unlocking the potential of sonelokimab, a novel investigational Nanobody® for the treatment of the inflammatory disease, to revolutionize outcomes for patients.

We continue to make significant progress in our Global Clinical Development Programs. The company’s focus is on inflammatory diseases with a major unmet need, including hidradenitis suppurativa and psoriatic arthritis – conditions affecting millions of people worldwide with a large need for improved treatment options. MoonLake was founded in 2021 and is headquarted in Zug, with hubs in Cambridge & Porto.

Further information is available at www.moonlaketx.com

title: Programa de Trainees

description:

title: Trainees | setembro 2026
Business Management Trainee
description:
About The Job

• Fully integrated in the BNP Paribas Group, BNP Paribas Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a leading provider of solutions to two client franchises: corporate and institutional clients, and operates across EMEA (Europe Middle East Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific) and the Americas
• BNP Paribas CIB strives to service the global economy by providing solutions to its clients in financing (ECM, DCM, specialized financing), flow banking (trade finance and cash management), financial advisory (M&A, project finance), global markets (interest rates, credit, foreign exchange, equity derivatives), risk management, and securities services
• CIB Analytics Consulting team (AC) consists of 60 people based in Paris, North America and Portugal. Reporting to the CIB Chief Data Officer, Analytics Consulting is an in-house centre of expertise on Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. It is at the forefront of the data transformation of BNP Paribas CIB and the team is constantly evolving. It helps internal entities (primarily CIB) best understand and use internal & external data. It offers to its internal client dashboarding, advanced analytics capabilities and AI applications in response to business projects and needs
• This trainee position sits within our Business Management practice which supports transversally all the activities we perform in Analytics Consulting across France and Portugal. This position has high exposure to Senior Management and offers a full perspective of the portfolio of projects we deliver 

Your Main Activities Are

• Support the business management of the team 
• Engage in the financial management of the team which includes: Time Management (Data quality and consistency, exception reports etc), Finance (Billing including end to end invoicing process, Budget including Forecast update etc), Portfolio Management (Resource Allocation, Project portfolio updates etc)
• Implement improvements to the existing and upcoming financial processes (automation, optimization, quality etc) 
• Support the management team in preparing Executive presentation and reports 
• Support HR and Recruitment processes 
• Engage in the recruitment of internal and external staff 
• Work with managers to update documentation for sourcing of candidates (create job description, etc) 
• Coordinate interview process with candidates and interviewers 
• Update candidate database tracking to ensure it's up to date at all steps of the process 
• Generic administrative support 
• Organize the onboarding and offboarding of team members (request for computer equipment, accesses, entitlements, etc) 
• Participate in team meetings by producing minutes and presentation materials
• Support and suggest improvements to our communication efforts internally and externally 
• Support management of various Team's activities including Team events, Visitors trip agenda etc

Profile And Skills To Success

• Bachelor or Master's degree in Management, Business Administration, Business Management or equivalent
• Excellent communication skills - oral & written 
• English fluent, French and Portuguese a plus 
• Proficient in MS Office Suite 
• Strong interest in Data and AI technologies
• Results driven 
• Organised and able to prioritise tasks 
• Detail oriented 

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

BNP Paribas, the European leader in banking and financial services in Europe, operates in 64 countries and has nearly 180,000 employees. The Group is structured around three operating divisions. Its business lines cooperate closely, as part of our integrated model, to meet the needs of all our clients in a coordinated manner

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities 
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate 

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. 

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

•  Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered.
•  In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

title: Finance Commercial Trainee
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Trainee in Finance Business Administration and immerse yourself in the dynamic world of financial management for our products and services in Western Europe. You will play a crucial role in monitoring the financial and commercial aspects of various customer orders, including costs, income, cash flow, and invoicing. Collaborating closely with Sales Managers, Project Managers, and global colleagues, you will ensure that all processes align with regulatory frameworks. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to our mission of transforming the industry while developing your skills in a supportive international environment.

How You’ll Make An Impact

• You will manage the commercial aspects of service orders, including order management, invoicing, and cost controlling, ensuring compliance with regulations.
• Collaborate with the Field Service team to provide commercial administration and support, including tax assessments.
• Take charge of accounts receivable management, ensuring timely invoicing and payments.
• Support digitalization initiatives within the finance sector to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
• Assist in monthly financial monitoring and reporting, contributing to forecasting and budgeting tasks.

What You Bring

• You have a background in finance, with a solid understanding of value flow and IFRS requirements.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and SAP is essential for success in this role.
• Your advanced communication skills enable you to connect effectively with remote teams and customers.
• You are fluent in English, and knowledge of Dutch or French is a plus.
• A willingness to travel to Belgium, France, or the Netherlands as needed for limited periods.

About The Team

You will be part of a dedicated team focused on the Finance Business Administration for Siemens Energy’s Transformation of Industry Business Area. This team is committed to ensuring the smooth commercial management of service orders and providing essential support for field service activities. By collaborating with various stakeholders, including sales and project management teams, you will contribute to the overall success of our operations in Western Europe. The team values initiative, proactivity, and strong communication, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemensenergy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team
• Competitive salary and meal allowance
• Fair compensation for international work
• Remote work permitted within the country
• Health insurance coverage
• Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad
• Access to a variety of employee resource groups https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs

title: Metro Potentials Trainee Programme
description:
Ready to kickstart your career journey with an immersive experience like no other? Look no further! The Metro Potentials Programme is your ticket to rapid learning and substantial growth in the exciting world of multichannel wholesale. Dive deep into diverse business areas, discovering and enhancing your strengths along the way. This isn't just any program—it's a dynamic adventure designed to push you out of your comfort zone and into new realms of possibility. Get ready to thrive! Our program is designed to guide ambitious graduates and talented young professionals towards leadership roles at METRO. With a strong foundation and customizable paths, your future success is in your hands.

🌟 Embark on an Exciting Learning Journey! 🌟

Are you ready for an adventure? The 18-month Metro Potentials Programme kicks off in September 2026, and it’s packed with opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Here’s what awaits you:

• Head Office Experience: Dive into the heart of our operations at the Metro Head Office. Gain practical insights, collaborate across units, and build essential cross-functional skills.
• Aviludo Branch Assignment: Roll up your sleeves and step onto the operations floor. Interact with customers, understand our business from the ground up, and forge connections with fellow employees.
• Global Exposure: Pack your bags! The third phase takes you to the Head Office of another METRO entity abroad. Immerse yourself in a new environment for 5 months, broadening your horizons.
• Project Ownership: Each phase comes with a project. Your contributions will shape our business and fuel your personal and professional growth.
• Customize Your Path: Work closely with your mentor to tailor your journey. Choose the content and duration of assignments that align with your aspirations.
• International Community: Join a vibrant group of trainees from diverse Metro countries and entities. Collaborate, learn, and expand your network.
• Training Weeks and Mentorship: Engage in international training weeks and receive guidance from seasoned leaders.

🌟 Qualifications for the Metro Potentials Programme 🌟

Are you ready to take the leap? Here’s what we’re looking for:

• Education: Recently obtained university degree.
• Language Skills: Fluent in both written and spoken English.
• Passion: A hunger for learning and personal growth.
• Commercial Acumen: Ready to dive into hands-on work in commercial functions.
• Leadership: A humble, natural leader who values diversity and thrives as part of a team.
• Ambition: Driven and ambitious—ready to make an impact.
• Communication Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Global Mindset: Willingness to work abroad for 5 months on an international assignment.
• Extracurricular Engagement: Bonus points if you’re involved in extracurricular activities.
• Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Apply now and let’s shape the future together! 🚀

Diversity and Inclusion are fundamental values at METRO and play a crucial role in our success. By fostering a culture of respect, equity, and equal opportunities, we create a work environment where all our employees feel valued and respected. That is why, at Aviludo, we embrace these values, creating a workplace where every individual has the opportunity to grow and contribute to our collective success.

title: Estágio Profissional - Segurança Contra Incêndios e Emergências
Performance Marketing Trainee
description:
Procuramos jovens talentos apaixonados por marketing digital e com uma vontade insaciável de aprender que queiram iniciar a sua carreira em Performance Marketing. Se estás pronto para fazer parte de uma equipa dinâmica e contribuir para campanhas de sucesso, esta oportunidade é para ti!

O Que Vais Fazer

• Apoiar na gestão, otimização e monitorização de campanhas no ecossistema de Google (Search, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook e Instagram), TikTok e outras plataformas de paid media.
• Participar na análise de resultados e na construção de reports, transformando dados em insights.
• Apoiar e aprender a desenvolver estratégias de marketing digital, compreendendo objetivos, KPIs e abordagem de media.
• Ter contacto progressivo com equipas de marca, participando em reuniões e apresentações de estratégia e resultados.

Requisitos

• Licenciatura em Gestão de Marketing, Publicidade ou área similar (concluída).
• Elegibilidade para o programa Estágios +Talento do IEFP.
• Elevada organização e atenção ao detalhe.
• Forte capacidade analítica e gosto por trabalhar com dados.
• Bons conhecimentos de Excel.
• Bom nível de inglês, oral e escrito.
• Paixão por marketing digital e vontade de aprender sobre gestão de campanhas.

title: Celfocus Academy | Analytics Engineer Trainee
description:
Start your journey in a learning‑driven environment, inside a fast‑paced and ever‑evolving world of tech and innovation.

At Celfocus, you’ll work with diverse teams on real projects and see how ideas turn into real impact.

Hybrid ways of working, international projects, and the space to explore different paths as you grow.

Explore your way in.

The opportunity

Analytics Engineer is responsible for providing clean and transformed data ready for analysis using ETL/ELT. Analytics Engineers should have an analytical perspective on the big picture around the data involved in the process.

Their mission is to design and implement data pipelines and analytical tools to support data-driven decision-making within an organization.

They work closely with data analysts, data scientists, and other stakeholders to understand their requirements and deliver robust analytical solutions to drive the company to be aligned and focused on its goals.

Your day-to-day

• Designing and implementing data integration workflows using ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, or Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS);
• Transforming data to meet the requirements of the target system or data warehouse;
• Loading transformed data into a data warehouse or other storage systems for reporting and analysis purposes;
• Collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure that data integration solutions support the organization's reporting and analysis needs;
• Monitoring and optimizing data integration processes to ensure that data is loaded efficiently and accurately.

What You’ll Bring

• Less than 1 year of effective experience in IT - This is a Celfocus Academy Opportunity
• Eagerness to learn
• Degree in Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Information Technologies and Systems, Computational Statistics, Data Analysis, or related.
• Know-how in working on development using languages such as SQL, PL/SQL, and TSQL, among others;
• Knowledge of Databases such as Oracle, Teradata, and Microsoft SQL Server, among others;
• Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies (e.g., Redshift, Big Query, Snowflake);
• Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and tools (e.g., Talend, Oracle ODI, Informatica Power Center, and DataStage);
• Understanding statistical analysis and data modeling techniques (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault);
• Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data services.

What’s In It For You

We are dedicated to fostering talent and nurturing the next generation of professionals. As part of our commitment to supporting junior team members, we offer a comprehensive training and mentoring program - Celfocus Academy - to help you excel in your career.

This is a personalized growth Program where you will be given a defined path and have a senior colleague dedicated to guiding you through every step of the way, being your counselor and your career advisor.

Your goals will be set and discussed to promote professional and personal growth through training and collaboration. Follow-up meetings happen three times a year, to assess your progress and adjust your goals.

The program includes

• Full-Time Permanent Contract: Enjoy the stability and security of a full-time position with Celfocus.
• Training and Mentoring Program: Benefit from our specialized training and mentoring initiatives designed specifically for junior team members. Our experienced professionals will guide you through hands-on learning experiences, ensuring you have the skills and knowledge to succeed.
• Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within. As you develop your skills and contribute to our team, you'll have the chance to advance your career within our organization.
• Collaborative Work Environment: Join a supportive and collaborative team where your ideas are valued, and your contributions make a difference.
• Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy a hybrid regime and flexible working hours.

To discover more about Celfocus Academy, please visit academy - Celfocus.

A place for everyone

At Celfocus, we are committed to cultivate a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an equal-opportunity employer, we welcome applicants of all backgrounds, gender identities, and abilities.

If you require any adjustments during the selection process, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team.

Celfocus is pioneering the future of business through Next-Gen Intelligence - the convergence of data, AI, and human creativity to build more autonomous and adaptive organisations. 

Guided by our core belief - Making Data Actionable - we partner with leading companies to co-create intelligent solutions that turn data into insight, agility, and business value.

Operating in over 25 countries, we bring together business experts, data scientists, and AI engineers to turn complexity into clarity and vision into measurable impact.

Founded in 2000, Celfocus is part of Novabase, listed on Euronext Lisbon.

To know more, visit www.celfocus.com

title: Wealth Management Markets Operations Trainee
description:
About The Job

• The trainee would share his/her time between one of the 3 teams: Markets Back Office (MBO), Cash Transfers (CT) and Funds Execution (FE)
• The Markets Back Office’s team is responsible for the booking, matching and settlement of Money Markets, Forex and Over-The-Counter (OTC) Derivatives operations
• Cash Transfers’ team is responsible for the processing of cash transfers operations according to clients’ instructions
• Funds Execution’s Team ensures the execution of all orders on investment funds, in the Wealth Management (WM) business line

Your Main Activities Are

• Assist MBO team on processing the booking of operations related to Forex and Money Market and managing the confirmations related to these products
• Execute for MBO team the necessary daily reconciliations
• Ensure for CT team the processing of client cash instructions (outgoing, manual instructions and incomings)
• Execute for CT team the treatment of standing orders, direct debits and prepaid cards 
• Help FE team on the execution of investment fund orders with custodians/transfer agents, in compliance with cut-offs and monitoring executed orders, pending’s orders, contract notes and reminders to the counterparties 
• Perform for FE team the controls and the enrichment of fund values in the referential database, as well as processing and responding to internal customer requests
• Implement internal procedures and directives concerning the respective team's activity, particularly in terms of controls 
• Ensure good quality of operations with respects of deadlines and guarantee effective and clear communication with Front Office, Relationship Managers’ and other teams that are part of the daily workflow

Profile And Skills To Success

• Bachelors’ Degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Business Management
• Up to 2 years of Experience in Banking and Financial Operations 
• Fluency in English
• Availability for a 12-month internship
• Ability to collaborate/Teamwork
• Attention to detail/rigor
• Client focused
• Communication skills
• Analytical Ability
• Proactivity

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

•  Rigor, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills to interpret industrial data. 
•  Affinity for technology and process digitalization (our daily work is done within the Google ecosystem, and you must be comfortable with or very willing to learn how to create AppSheets). 
•  Good communication skills, empathy, and ease in interacting with different operational and management levels. 
•  Dynamic, organized profile with the initiative to propose new solutions and improvements.

title: Field Operations Associate (Lisbon, Entry Level)
description:
🎩 Job Title: Field Operations Associate

📍 Location: Lisbon, Portugal (Field work across the city + Home Office flexibility)

🗂️ Type: Full-Time | 6-month IEFP internship, converting to full-time work contract

🎓 Experience: 0+ years (Recent graduates and early-career candidates welcome)

Most entry-level jobs are a slow death by spreadsheet. This one puts you in the streets of Lisbon, in rooms that matter, getting things done that actually move a business forward.

BRIDGE IN is the infrastructure layer that lets international companies land and operate in Southern Europe without getting buried in compliance chaos. We handle the boring so our clients can focus on building. But "handling the boring" in the real world requires a person on the ground who can walk into a bank, a notary, or a government office and actually get things done. That's this role.

Why BRIDGE IN?

🌍 We are a bootstrapped, profitable startup ranked among the fastest-growing companies in Southern Europe, with clients from over 35 countries and a track record of helping 7 unicorns create jobs in Portugal. No VC money, no hype, just execution and value creation.

This role exists because our physical operations in Lisbon are growing faster than our current capacity. The person we hire will directly support that expansion, touching real clients, real documents, and real consequences from day one.

We are also leveraging the IEFP +Talento program to make this hire, which means the role comes with a structured internship framework and a clear path to a full-time work contract after 6 months. More on eligibility below.

What You'll Be Doing

🚀 This is not a "shadow someone and make coffee" internship. You will own a set of real operational responsibilities from your first weeks.

• Navigate Lisbon on behalf of our clients. Banks, notaries, government offices, post offices, client headquarters. You will know every relevant address in this city better than the people who work there. 
• Handle high-stakes documentation. Collecting, verifying, and submitting paperwork that has real legal and reputational weight. A senior legal and accounting team supports you, but the judgment call in the field is yours. 
• Guide international clients through local processes. You will accompany clients at banks and offices, acting as their local guide. You adapt your register depending on who is in the room, a conservative branch manager or a first-time founder who flew in from US or Singapore. 
• Break through bureaucratic walls. When a process stalls, you do not wait for an email chain to solve it. You go to the source, ask the right question, and find the path forward. 
• Feed operational intelligence back to the team. When you spot a pattern, a bottleneck, or a smarter way to do something, you flag it. We use tools like N8N to automate what can be automated, and your field experience helps us know what that is. 

Who You Are

• You are under 35 years old, hold a university degree (completed) 
• You are based in or able to commute within Lisbon 
• You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, written and spoken. You will need both, often at the same time. 
• You have high agency. You do not need someone to tell you what to do next when things go sideways. 
• You are organized in a way that matters, not just tidy folders, but zero dropped balls on time-sensitive, consequential tasks. 
• You are a people person without being performative about it. Professional, warm, and adaptable depending on the room. 
• You are comfortable being on the move. This role involves real physical presence across the city, not a desk all day. 
• Public transport in Lisbon is your friend. No personal vehicle required. 

What We Offer

• A real internship with a real conversion. Complete the 6 months with successful performance, and you get a full-time work contract. No ambiguity. 
• Compensation aligned with the IEFP +Talento grant, structured and transparent from day one. 
• Zero micromanagement. You own your route and your schedule. The mission is what gets tracked, not your check-in time. 
• Remote flexibility when you are not in the field. Home office, coffee shop, wherever you work best. 
• A learning curve that most people do not get until much later in their careers. In 6 months, you will understand how international businesses actually incorporate, operate, and survive in Southern Europe. 
• A team that promotes based on output and outcome, not tenure or title. 

What Happens Next

We don't do corporate black holes. This is a real, open role, and not a ghost job to harvest resumes. Here is the general roadmap: start with a quick application form. If we're aligned, we'll send over a self-evaluation survey, followed by human-to-human interviews and a hands-on challenge so you can show, not just tell, what you can do. We're a startup, so the exact steps might iterate, but we guarantee three things: we (try to) move fast, we are radically transparent, and we will never waste your time.

title: Internship Position - Technical Customer Service
description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

The Technical Customer Services team plays a key role in delivering a smooth and reliable experience to our enterprise and B2B customers around the world. This internship is part of a dedicated team that handles more complex and technical customer cases, working closely with both Customer Support and Technical Support teams to find effective solutions.

You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals across different areas of the business, gaining hands-on exposure to telecommunications, troubleshooting, and customer operations in a fast-paced international environment.

About the Role

As a Technical Customer Services Intern, you will support the team in investigating and resolving technical and operational customer issues related to mobile connectivity services. You'll learn how to manage customer cases, collaborate with different internal teams, and contribute to delivering a high-quality customer experience

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

• Supporting the resolution of technical and operational queries from enterprise customers 
• Assisting with the investigation and follow-up of more complex customer cases 
• Monitoring and updating support tickets within agreed service levels 
• Working closely with Technical Support and other internal teams to help track and resolve issues 
• Helping document troubleshooting steps, processes, and customer interactions 
• Supporting Service Account Managers with operational and customer-related activities 
• Contributing ideas and improvements to internal processes and team workflows 
• Developing knowledge of mobile telecommunications services including calls, SMS, data, and eSIM solutions
 

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
• A proactive mindset and willingness to learn
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
• Interest in technology, telecommunications, and customer operations
• Comfortable working in a collaborative and fast-paced environment
• Good organizational and teamwork skills
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office tools and collaborative platforms

Nice-to-haves

• Familiarity with ticketing systems or CRM platforms 
• Basic understanding of mobile telecommunications, connectivity, GSM and VoIP technologies 
• Experience working in multicultural or international environments

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

 •  Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
 •  Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
 •  Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
 •  Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
 •  Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
 •  International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
 •  Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
 •  Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry
 
1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Startup Operator, Lisbon Field & Client Operations
description:
Job title: Startup Operator, Lisbon Field & Client Operations

Location: Lisbon, Portugal (Regular field work; otherwise Home Office)

Type: Full-Time (6-month internship + full-time contract)

Experience: 0+ (Recent Grads & Young Professionals)

Opportunity & Merit is one of BRIDGE IN’s values. This job opening is all about giving the opportunity to a young, talented person with high agency to get a job in a fast-growing startup and be recognized for the output and outcome of their work.

We are leveraging the Portuguese IEFP +Talento program to turn a high-potential grad into a startup operator. If you’re a recent graduate (under 35) eligible for the IEFP +Talento program, you’re the profile we’re looking to invest in. You can have previous working experience, but it isn’t required. If you complete the internship program successfully, you’ll be offered a work contract after 6 months.

Never a dull moment.

Most entry-level jobs involve dying slowly, staring at a screen for 8 hours a day, and doing boring, repetitive work. This isn't one of them. We hire for potential, not past glory. If you have the brains and the grit, we’ll give you the tools to make an actual impact.

Sure, we might have some repetitive work, but we are using AI and N8N to automate most of it and release people to do higher-value work. At BRIDGE IN, we provide the infrastructure for companies to grow. That infrastructure isn't just code, it’s real-world execution. We are looking for a Startup Operator to be our "boots on the ground" in Lisbon. You are the person who makes the impossible happen in the physical world, while others might be stuck in online calls.

Getting things done. That’s your role.

We believe in Operational Excellence. Your job is to ensure that the physical side of our business: the paperwork, banking, logistics, all run like a Swiss watch.

• Field Navigator: You’ll be on the move across Lisbon, moving between our and our customers’ offices, banks, post office, and government entities, as needed. When you aren’t required to go to a location, you have the flexibility to work from home or wherever you prefer. 
• Document Maniac: You’ll be responsible for collecting, verifying, and submitting high-stakes paperwork. You’ll have a senior legal and accounting team behind you, but you need to show great judgment and a sense of organization and responsibility. This is binary, as our clients’ operations depend entirely on your accuracy. 
• Customer Diplomat: You will meet our international customers at banks and offices to guide them through local processes. Whether you're talking to a conservative bank manager or a frantic startup founder, you keep it smooth, professional, and pleasant. You need to be adaptable, command good English, and be generally pleasant to be with. We don’t need a snake-oil salesman, we need someone who builds immediate trust. 
• Professional Hustler: When a process gets stuck in bureaucracy, you don't wait for an email. You go to the source, ask the right questions, and find the workaround. For you to excel in the position, you need to have high agency. The solution will not land on your lap. 

Why Join Us?

• No Experience? No Problem. We hire for cultural fit and brain-power. You’ll learn the rest from our awesome team. 
• Zero Micro-management. We trust you to own your schedule and your route. As long as the mission is accomplished, you have the lead. 
• Experience in Dog Years: You’ll learn more about the reality of business incorporation and international operations in 6 months than most people learn in 5 years of business school. 
• No Glass Ceiling. You’ll progress as quickly as the business value you create. We optimize for outcomes, not age or previous experience. 

Who the hell is BRIDGE IN?

BRIDGE IN is a bootstrapped, profitable (€22M+ Rev ITD), and remote-first company with the vision of eliminating the burden of bureaucracy by leveraging technology and innovation, empowering organizations worldwide to create opportunities and freeing people to focus on meaningful work.

🚀 You might have seen BRIDGE IN on lists like Top 10 Portuguese Startups, elected as the 15th Fastest-Growing Company in Southern Europe, or being #5 on the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 ranking. That's cool, but what it really means is that we've been able to create momentum by sheer determination and value creation, no speculative VC-fueled pipe dreams.

Ready to apply?

Great! Our selection process is designed to be as thoughtful and analytical as the business we're building. It begins with a data-driven review of your experience and culminates in a human-to-human discussion to ensure we're a great fit for each other.

Be ready to tell us about a time you hacked a system, solved a logistical nightmare, or refused to take 'no' for an answer. Show us your agency.

COMEÇA AQUI

O Santander (www.santander.com) está a evoluir de uma marca global de grande impacto para uma organização orientada pela tecnologia, e as nossas pessoas estão no centro desta jornada.

Juntos, estamos a liderar uma transformação centrada no cliente, que valoriza o pensamento crítico, a inovação e a coragem de desafiar o que é possível.

Esta é mais do que uma mudança estratégica. É uma oportunidade para pessoas motivadas crescerem, aprenderem e fazerem uma diferença real.

A nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem. Adotámos uma cultura de risco sólida, e todas as nossas pessoas, em todos os níveis, têm um papel ativo e responsável na gestão de riscos.

O Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) é a divisão global do Santander que apoia alguns dos clientes corporativos e institucionais mais complexos e sofisticados do mundo, oferecendo serviços personalizados e produtos wholesale de valor acrescentado, para responder da melhor forma às suas necessidades.

O TEU IMPACTO

A área de Mercados do Santander (incorporada na estrutura Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) está à procura de um(a) Estagiário(a) para a Sala de Mercados, para Lisboa, pelo prazo de 12 meses.

Esta oportunidade permitirá acompanhar de perto a atividade dos mercados financeiros, apoiando as equipas na análise, preparação e acompanhamento de soluções para clientes, num ambiente dinâmico, exigente e com forte exposição ao negócio.

Estamos a redefinir a forma como trabalhamos através da inovação, da tecnologia de ponta, da colaboração e da liberdade para explorar novas ideias.

Para ter sucesso nesta função, serás responsável por:

•  Apoiar a equipa da Sala de Mercados no acompanhamento diário da evolução dos mercados financeiros, incluindo taxas de juro, câmbios, crédito e outros ativos relevantes;
•  Preparar análises, mapas de acompanhamento e apresentações de suporte à atividade comercial e à interação com clientes;
•  Apoiar na recolha, tratamento e validação de informação de mercado, financeira e transacional;
•  Colaborar na preparação de propostas, cotações indicativas e materiais de apoio relacionados com produtos de mercados, sempre sob supervisão da equipa;
•  Apoiar o acompanhamento de operações e a articulação com equipas internas, nomeadamente áreas comerciais, middle office, risco, compliance e operações;
•  Contribuir para iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automatização de tarefas e desenvolvimento de ferramentas de apoio à atividade da Sala de Mercados;
•  Assegurar rigor, organização e qualidade na informação produzida, respeitando os procedimentos internos, regras de controlo e enquadramento regulamentar aplicável. 

O TEU CONTRIBUTO

As nossas pessoas são a nossa maior força. Cada indivíduo contribui com perspetivas únicas que nos tornam mais fortes como equipa e como organização.

Capacitamos as equipas para irem mais além, valorizando quem são e potenciando o que trazem consigo.

Os seguintes requisitos representam os conhecimentos, competências e capacidades essenciais para o sucesso nesta função. Serão consideradas adaptações razoáveis para permitir que pessoas com deficiência possam desempenhar as funções essenciais.

•  Interesse demonstrado por mercados financeiros, banca, produtos financeiros e acompanhamento macroeconómico (Obrigatório)
•  Experiência anterior em estágio, projetos académicos, associação de estudantes, finance club ou atividades relacionadas com mercados financeiros, banca ou corporate finance (Preferencial)

Formação Académica

•  Licenciatura concluída ou em fase final nas áreas de Economia, Gestão, Finanças, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas similares (Obrigatório)
•  Forte capacidade analítica e gosto por temas financeiros, quantitativos e de mercado (Obrigatório)
•  Mestrado ou formação complementar em Finanças, Mercados Financeiros, Economia, Data Analytics ou áreas relacionadas (Preferencial)

Idiomas

•  Português fluente (Obrigatório)
•  Inglês avançado, escrito e falado (Obrigatório)
•  Espanhol (Preferencial)

Hard Skills

•  Bons conhecimentos de Microsoft Excel e PowerPoint (Obrigatório)
•  Capacidade de análise, tratamento e apresentação de informação financeira e de mercado (Obrigatório)
•  Conhecimentos de Bloomberg, Refinitiv, VBA, Python, Power BI ou outras ferramentas de análise de dados (Preferencial)

Soft Skills

•  Rigor, sentido de responsabilidade e atenção ao detalhe;
•  Curiosidade intelectual, proatividade e vontade de aprender;
•  Boa capacidade de comunicação, espírito de equipa e adaptação a ambientes dinâmicos e exigentes. 

VALORIZAMOS O TEU IMPACTO

A tua contribuição é importante e será reconhecida. Podes esperar um pacote de remuneração justo e competitivo, que reflete o impacto que crias e o valor que entregas.

Mas sabemos que as recompensas vão muito além dos números.

•  Oferecemos mais do que um salário. Os nossos benefícios foram concebidos para apoiar a tua vida, os teus objetivos e o teu bem-estar, agora e no futuro. 
•  A tua saúde é a nossa prioridade. Através do BeHealthy, o nosso programa global de bem-estar, promovemos o bem-estar holístico. 
•  Sabemos que a família é tudo. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental, apoio à infância e programas adaptados a cada fase da vida.

Estamos aqui para te manter motivado(a), ajudar-te a alcançar os teus objetivos e celebrar o teu progresso em cada etapa do caminho.

CONFORMIDADE LOCAL

title: GenAI Trainee
description:
Euronext is the leading pan-European market infrastructure, connecting local economies to global capital markets. Within the COO scope, the AI Team identifies, prioritizes and delivers innovative AI solutions that drive business value across the organization — from conversational agents to document intelligence, from browsing automation to agentic orchestration.

About The AI Trainee Program

This is a 12-month development program with hands-on experience across the full AI lifecycle. You will join a structured program that includes:

• 1-week centralized onboarding on enterprise AI tools, platforms, governance and responsible AI
• 2–3 real use cases end-to-end, from proof of concept to production deployment
• Two international trips to other Euronext locations (e.g. Paris, Milan, Athens) for cross-team collaboration on real business projects
• Buddy assignment and continuous mentoring from senior AI developers, MLOps and data professionals
• Training on cutting-edge AI tools — you will regularly test and get hands-on experience with the latest AI technologies, frameworks and platforms as they emerge
• Meal allowance, business travel opportunities, and 24 company holidays per year

What You Will Work On

You will contribute to production-grade Generative AI solutions that serve real business teams across Europe. Examples include:

• Building and improving AI agents that autonomously browse websites, extract data and validate regulatory information
• Developing RAG-based chatbots and conversational assistants for internal and external users
• Creating document intelligence pipelines that parse, classify and extract structured data from complex financial documents
• Integrating AI capabilities via REST APIs, MCP servers and agentic orchestration frameworks
• Supporting monitoring, testing and troubleshooting of AI solutions in production
• Collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements, iterate on solutions and deliver training

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or in final year) in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field
• Solid knowledge of Python and software development best practices
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
• Understanding of machine learning, deep learning and generative AI concepts
• Interest in LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering and AI agents
• Awareness of RESTful APIs, at least from a user's perspective
• Nice to have: exposure to cloud services (AWS or Azure), FastAPI, or frontend development
• Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on, execution-oriented mindset
• Fluency in English and Portuguese, both written and spoken
• A collaborative attitude with genuine curiosity for emerging AI technologies

Why Euronext

You will join a global AI team working at the frontier of enterprise Generative AI — building agents, orchestrating tools, and deploying solutions that operate at scale in regulated financial markets. This is not a theoretical internship: you will ship code to production, interact with business users across Europe, and gain experience with technologies that define the future of AI engineering.

title: Trainee - Professional Ethics
description:
About The Job

• The Compliance Function is an independent and integrated function of BNP Paribas Group. The overall mission of Compliance is, through second level control, to give reasonable assurance to senior management, that compliance, regulatory and reputational risks are monitored, controlled and mitigated as relevant
• Reporting to the Head of Professional Ethics (PE) within Compliance Territory Portugal

Your Main Activities Are

• Advise and provide support on PE domain through a critical analysis of the applicable Group/Local policies and procedures
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of internal controls for efficient PE oversight
• Support the Control team by providing the relevant information for the execution of the Generic Control Plans within the PE domain
• Contribute to audit missions on PE by providing the relevant information
• Coordinate the assessment of nearshoring initiatives and, when competent, provide a compliance opinion
• Contribute to the development of the PE Compliance framework within Territory Compliance Portugal
• Establish good and clear communication with key stakeholders inside / outside Compliance
• Promote a strong Compliance culture and awareness of the applicable PE Compliance procedures

Profile and Skills to Success

• Bachelor's Degree in Law / Economics or related
• Advanced level of English, both written and oral
• Knowledge in MS Office Pack
• Autonomy
• Ability to understand a legal / regulatory text
• Analytical ability
• Communication skills, both written and oral
• Organisational skills

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

The Main Missions Of The Role Are To

• Support to build up the Procurement Program and leveling piece procurements.

Your profile and competencies to succeed

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent

• Office Tools (Preference Excel)

What We Can Do For You

• At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies. 
• We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development. 
• We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count. 
• We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world) 
• We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans. 
• Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.

title: Engenheiro/a Mecânico/a Junior
[Junior] Service Delivery Engineer (electrical/analytics)
description:
Who we are

 Jungle develops and applies Artificial Intelligence to increase the uptime and performance of renewable energy assets, maritime vessels and industrial machines. Built on existing sensors and data streams, the company’s technology enables asset owners to squeeze more out of their assets, accelerating the world’s transition to renewable energy sources.

We have productised our services into a web application that we constantly improve to ensure that our best analyses and visualisations help our users get the maximum energy and performance out of their assets. We operate at a large scale - millions of data points per day - providing always-on predictive models, alarms and metrics visualisations for some of the largest and most sophisticated customers in the global renewable energy space.

What is the position

We’re looking for an experienced electrical / mechanical / naval engineer, who wants to use their skills and experience to ensure that Jungle’s solutions have the maximum impact on the operations of our customers.

You’ll work directly with our customers to help them solve their challenges with Jungle’s products, and get the most value from our AI-based solutions.

As part of our Service Delivery team, your mission is to guide the implementation and adoption of Jungle’s products - Canopy and Toucan with our customers.

With the help of Jungle’s in-house tools, you will train, test and deploy Machine Learning models to our customers and help them understand the possibilities and limitations of our products.

Using your technical knowledge, you will help customers understand the results and translate them to hypotheses and follow-up actions, ensuring their machines work to the best of their ability, now and in the future.

Why do we need you?

• You will use your electromechanical technical knowledge to discover, on a daily basis, ongoing failures, anomalies and identify machine underperformance supported by our machine learning models.
• You will keep good and close relationships with Jungle's customers, ensuring that we understand their needs well and that they reap the benefits from using Jungle’s products.
• You will act as a cross-functional liaison between our customers and both our Product and Software Engineering teams, ensuring that our roadmap is aligned with our customers’ needs.
• We are building technology to automate our activities as possible. By providing feedback about our tools you will enable Jungle engineers to work more efficiently.
• You will use your analytics skills to perform analyses and reports (based on sensor data) that help us track and monitor the impact of our solutions for our customers.

Requirements

• You have a MSc degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Naval/Marine Engineering or related technical field, or you have equivalent experience.
• Experience (1-2 years of professional experience is highly valued) in working with (sensor) data of electromechanical assets.
• You enjoy helping customers solve deeply technical problems.
• You possess well-developed soft skills, and are comfortable talking about in-depth matter with customers and industry experts.
• You have an eye for detail, but know how to trade-off details for the bigger picture.
• You can think creatively and laterally whilst remaining practical and solution-oriented.
• You have data wrangling experience with Python (Jupyter Notebooks, Numpy, Pandas/Polars and visualisation libraries e.g. Plotly).
• [bonus] Conceptual understanding of Machine Learning, its power and limitations.

About you

Strong technical acumen and ability to apply commercially. 

• You are comfortable communicating technical concepts to people of all backgrounds.
• Experience in interpreting data and delivering insights that drive customer value.
Engaging personality, polished verbal and written communication skills. 

• Building strong relationships is a natural thing for you.
• Business level fluency in English, other languages are a plus.
Sharp analytical mind and tech skills to implement them. 

• You have the domain knowledge to monitor, understand and analyse sensor data and the curious and sharp mindset to find problems in our customers’ assets.
• You have the technical skills to perform analyses and reports that are of value to our customers.

Why join us?

• Join a established start-up in the scaling phase.
• Work with modern technologies (both in ML and software engineering).
• You’ll work on the last-mile delivery of our products, ensuring they have the best impact with our customers.
• You have the opportunity to use your skills to create a meaningful change in this world.
• Become part of a warm and skilled group of people, committed to each other’s success.
• We care about your growth and assign you a personal mentor to help you achieve this.
• We offer you a flexible work schedule, holiday policy, and work location. 
• We are a fully remote company.

“A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Strong problem-solving and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively. Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement. A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies—especially artificial intelligence—paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative."

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in teams

Bring out your best

title: Data Analyst Trainee
description:
About The Job

• The Transaction Banking business concerns two fundamental business lines:
• Cash Management: all products that assist our customers with their liquidity needs (current accounts, term deposits, payments & collections, forex)
• Global Trade Solutions: all products that assist our customers with their global trade needs (letters of credit, guarantees, supply chain management, factoring)
• As Transaction Banking Chief Operating Officer (TB COO) team, we assist our different business team in multiple topics, both on daily/monthly needs as in project mode. Within the COO team we have a small team of data scientists focusing on data, who are involved in the data use cases from exploration phase up to production delivery.
• This position provides an excellent opportunity to learn about the overall banking industry as a whole, more specifically dealing with the Transaction Banking business across all regions (EMEA, APAC, AMER)
• The Data Analyst Trainee’s main mission is to provide support to the Cash Management fee analysis Unit and to contribute to the pricing to billing initiatives

Your Main Activities Are

• Automate business dashboards as prototypes and prepare them to be put in production, working closely with the team´s data analysts
• Report to Top line TB Management and TB COO on all data queries and data needs
• Contribute to the development and governance of our data and support the different Cash Management business line with data-driven decision-making
• Meet different stakeholders to frame their data needs, based on your findings collect the necessary data, process the data, and turn it into meaningful tools meeting the requirements expressed by the teams
• Participate and interact with inter-disciplinary teams such as IT, Business and Operations and contribute to the improvement and streamlining of data systems within the company to drive innovation

Profile And Skills To Success

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Business Intelligence, Business, Economics or Mathematics
• Fluency in English
• Highly proficient with MS Excel
• Ability to quickly comprehend new software tools and learn how to use them optimally
• Great attention to detail
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and influence skills
• Good conceptualization skills and data exposure
• Open, curious and eager to learn and discover day to day banking products

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

• Leading banking institution

Leading player in banking and financial services in Europe, BNP Paribas operates in 64 countries and has nearly 178,000 employees, including more than 144,000 in Europe

• International reach 

The Group holds key positions in several areas of banking and financial services that are structured around three operating divisions:

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) connects companies needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities division that offers tailored financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients.
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS) brings together all our commercial banks and several specialised businesses
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS) combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real estate including specialised businesses offering a wide range of savings, investment and protection services
• Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.220 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 centres of expertise providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

• Diversity and Inclusion commitment 

BNP Paribas ´ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility – Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

• Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

• Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

title: Global Finance Intern
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Finance Analyst Intern, you will rotate across multiple Finance teams within BCG’s Lisbon Capability Center, gaining exposure to a broad range of financial operations, planning, analytics, and business partnering activities. This 12-month internship is designed to provide hands-on experience across different finance environments while building foundational technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a collaborative global setting.

You will work closely with Finance professionals supporting teams including Global FP&A, Commercial Finance, Specialty Business Unit Finance, and Finance Business Partnering. Throughout the program, you will contribute to operational and analytical workstreams while exploring opportunities to improve processes, automate recurring activities, and apply AI-enabled solutions to day-to-day finance workflows.

• Support financial analysis, reporting, and operational activities across rotating Finance teams
• Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and business performance tracking activities
• Assist with data analysis, reporting preparation, and insight generation for stakeholders
• Help identify opportunities to improve finance processes, workflows, and team efficiency
• Support automation and AI-enabled initiatives that enhance day-to-day finance operations
• Collaborate with global and cross-functional teams on ongoing projects and operational priorities
• Participate in a capstone project focused on operational improvement and/or process automation
• Build familiarity with BCG finance tools, systems, and ways of working through hands-on experience

What You'll Bring

• You are completing or recently completed a degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field
• You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
• You are comfortable working with large sets of data and interpreting financial or operational information
• You demonstrate curiosity about strategic planning, process improvement, automation, and AI applications in business environments
• You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders
• You are adaptable, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a rotational environment
• You manage priorities effectively and deliver high-quality work within deadlines

Who You'll Work With

You will work with a broad network of Finance professionals across BCG’s Lisbon Capability Center, including teams in Global FP&A, Commercial Finance, Specialty Business Unit Finance, and Finance Business Partnering. Throughout the program, you will collaborate with colleagues across different functions, teams, and geographies while gaining exposure to a variety of finance activities and business priorities.

You will work closely with managers and team members who will support your development through hands-on learning, mentorship, and rotational experiences. The program is designed to provide exposure to different ways of working across Finance while helping you build foundational business, analytical, and collaboration skills in a global environment.

Additional info

This is a paid, 12-month rotational internship program based in Lisbon, Portugal. Interns will rotate across two Finance teams during the program, with approximately six months spent in each team. The internship includes onboarding, hands-on project experience, and a capstone project focused on operational improvement and/or automation initiatives.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Porto to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.

You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.

• Organization: Alignerr
• Type: Hourly Contract

What You'll Do

• Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains

• Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
