• Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
• Strong problem-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
• Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
• Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

• Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
• Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
• Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
• Competitive programming, open-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
• Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs

title: Digital Process Automation Graduate
description:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €39.7 billion in 2024 and currently employs around 95,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2024, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.9 billion euros. Continental's tire division employs more than 57,000 people worldwide and has 20 production and 16 development sites.

Are you passionate about automation, digital innovation, and solving real business challenges?

Join our 18-month Marketing & Sales Graduate Program and become a key driver of process automation across Spain & Portugal, while gaining international experience and building a strong foundation for your future career.

You will:

🔹 Lead process automation initiatives across Iberia (Spain & Portugal)

🔹 Roll out automation solutions across locations, adapting them to local needs

🔹 Identify opportunities to automate and propose smart, scalable solutions

🔹 Collaborate with IT, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver impact

🔹 Ensure strong data governance and access management

🔹 Contribute to decisions on technology and infrastructure

🔹 Track and report KPIs to drive continuous improvement

👉 In short: you’ll help shape how we work—making processes smarter, faster, and more efficient.

Phase 1 – Learn & Contribute (Spain)

Build your foundation while working on impactful automation projects and getting to know our business.

Phase 2 – Go Global (6 months abroad)

Expand your horizons in an international team (e.g., HQ in Hanover or another EMEA location). Collaborate, learn, and grow globally.

Phase 3 – Shape Your Future

Return ready to step into your long-term role and make an immediate impact.

✨ What Makes This Opportunity Special?

✅ Real responsibilities from day one

✅ International exposure 🌍

✅ Hands-on experience with cutting-edge automation tools

✅ Strong network across local & global teams

✅ A clear path toward your future career

🎯 Who We’re Looking For

You’re curious, proactive, and excited about technology & process improvement. You enjoy working with different teams and turning ideas into real solutions.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in business studies, economics, informatics, or a related field
• Interest in Marketing & Sales, in international collaboration, and a long-term career in our global organization
• Hands-on experience from internships or working student positions that demonstrate your drive and adaptability
• Sharp analytical and structured thinking abilities - you thrive on breaking down complex challenges and creating innovative solutions
• UiPath certification(s), knowledge of Power Automate or other RPA platforms. 
• Knowledge of data processing tools and techniques (PowerQuery, KNIME, SQL)
• Familiarity with IT infrastructure (virtual machines, authorizations, applications)
• Understanding concepts and principles of programming language
• Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems
• Fluency in English and local language (Portuguese). Spanish is a plus
• Proven intercultural experience and mobility- you have worked or studied abroad and are excited about working abroad during the Graduate Program

Additional Information

• Your work with us will be fairly compensated: We recognize the value of your contribution and want to ensure you are appropriately rewarded (e.g. Performance Bonus and seniority Bonus)
• We offer flexible working hours with hybrid work models, giving you the opportunity to occasionally work from home — because we understand how important the balance between personal and professional life is. 
• You will receive qualified support from our experienced professionals to enhance your technical knowledge and practical skills – you’ll gain a solid overview of corporate finance and its interfaces within a multinational organization. 
• Benefit from a wide range of discounts and special offers through our corporate benefits program – from fashion and leisure activities to tech products.

• Local employment contract;

description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities

• Be able to correctly perform all tasks in the company's ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning): Update of customer and intercompany prices; Placing open orders, closed orders and canceled orders (for parts, transport, D&D) for external customers for all European plants and internal customers;
• Maintaining material master data and creating material information record;
• Support Sales Administration and cooperate with the Accounts Receivable team to support any topic related to invoicing and cash tracking;
• Be able to manage and carry out tasks necessary to achieve the goals of the work group and the organization: Archive documents and reports; Participate in Problem Solving Groups and/or participate in improvement groups with a view to solving problems; Propose solutions and methodologies that contribute to the optimization of teamwork processes.

Your profile and competencies to succeed

• High school or Degree in business or Similar;
• Good with computer skills (MS Office), Knowledge of SAP is a plus;
• Good communication skills in English (mandatory), French or German or Spanish (valued);
• Analytical mindset. 

What We Can Do For You

• At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies. 
• We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development. 
• We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count. 
• We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world) 
• We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans. 
• Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy. 

Why join us

FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.

title: Siemens Energy Graduate Program - Digital Strategy and Business Partnering (m/f/d)
description:
Whether you’re a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you are the future of innovation and leadership. That’s why the global Siemens Energy Graduate Program can help you unleash your full potential. With guidance from experienced mentors, extensive training opportunities, and the chance to expand your global network, you will grow both your career and your personal capabilities.

What You Can Expect

Over two exciting years, you’ll gain hands-on experiences and become an active part of your team’s daily activities. Through impactful projects in three customized assignments – including an eight‑month international placement – you’ll gain a deep understanding of Siemens Energy. A dedicated mentor will support you every step of the way, giving you the chance to explore different roles, engage in immersive experiences, and build a strong network with peers and industry leaders. As part of the team , you will work closely with a fast‑growing business and contribute to defining the digital strategy that will support its expansion.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As part of our Graduate Program, you are on the Siemens Energy team. You’ll share our purpose in energizing society by supporting customers with transitioning to a more sustainable world and work on real global issues, creating solutions that directly make an impact.

• Conduct business analysis to understand requirements, gather insights from stakeholders, and support documentation efforts.
• Act as a strategic partner by collaborating across product lines—such as turbine engineering—and bridging communication with AI development teams.
• Contribute to cross‑functional projects, supporting digital transformation initiatives within the organization.

What You Bring

• Strong interest in AI, automation, digitalization, and process improvement
• Practical experience from internships or working‑student roles; up to 36 months of additional full‑time experience welcome
• A master’s or doctoral degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field
• Ability to perform business analysis, work in agile teams, and collaborate across engineering and digital functions
• Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to connect business requirements with technical development
• Minimum 3 months of international experience, and excellent English skills with openness to international travel

Gas Services

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Siemens Energy Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by at least 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Recruitment Process 

We undertake a detailed selection process comprising the following stages: CV screening, test assessment, video interview, and a final panel interview. You’ll receive the necessary details ahead of each stage as you progress!

Siemens Energy Graduate Program Website: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/company/jobs/graduate-program.html

title: Back End Developer
description:
Backend Engineering Opportunities

Roles include: Market Maker Engineer, Junior Backend Developer, API Backend Developer and Backend Developer Intern

Location: Lisbon, Portugal, hybrid, around 4 days per week on-site

Salary: €30,000 to €70,000 depending on experience

Sector: Sports technology, trading, betting, prediction markets and real-time data

We’re working with a fast-growing technology company in Lisbon that is building high-performance backend systems across sports data, odds feeds, APIs, trading and prediction market infrastructure.

This is a great opportunity for backend-first engineers at different stages of their career, from interns and early-career developers through to junior-mid engineers with stronger commercial experience. You do not need to be the finished article, but you do need to be hands-on, curious and able to show real evidence of what you have built.

The roles available

Market Maker Engineer

You will help design and improve market-making systems, supporting reliable and scalable execution across multiple exchanges. This role is ideal for someone interested in latency, real-time order management, high-frequency data and the crossover between technology, finance and trading systems.

Junior Backend Developer

You will help build and deploy scalable backend services and API infrastructure, working closely with a small engineering team. This role suits someone with solid backend experience who wants more ownership and exposure to real-time, performance-sensitive systems.

API Backend Developer

You will work closely on odds feed API infrastructure, including databases, data mapping, scheduling systems and scraping networks. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys backend infrastructure, scalable APIs, data reliability and solving practical engineering problems.

Backend Developer Intern

You will support backend, scraping, mapping and API-related work while learning directly from a small, hands-on engineering team. This is ideal for someone technically strong, proactive and ready to apply their skills in a real commercial environment.

What’s in it for you?

• Salary from €30,000 to €70,000 depending on experience.

• Multiple opportunities across backend, API, market-making and intern-level roles.

• Join a young, fast-moving technology company in Lisbon.

• Work on real-time backend systems across sports, trading, odds and prediction markets.

• Build APIs, data infrastructure and performance-sensitive backend services.

• Work closely with a small engineering team where your input will matter.

• Get exposure to high-frequency data flows, market-making infrastructure and live execution systems.

• Great opportunity for early-career and junior-mid engineers to step up quickly.

• Hybrid working, with around 4 days per week on-site in Lisbon.

• Work in a commercial environment where shipped projects and practical ability matter more than perfect CVs.

• Opportunity to grow with a business operating in a highly relevant area of fintech, sports technology and real-time data.

More about the client and the role

Our client is hiring across several closely related backend engineering roles, with each opportunity sitting around the same core environment: real-time data, APIs, sports, odds, betting, trading and prediction markets.

The team builds and maintains systems that support odds feeds, data mapping, scheduling, scraping, APIs, real-time execution, database infrastructure and market-making workflows.

Depending on your experience and which role is the best fit, the work may involve:

• Building and improving backend services using Node.js, TypeScript and SQL.

• Developing scalable API infrastructure.

• Working with real-time data flows, WebSockets, streaming systems or high-throughput services.

• Supporting odds feed API infrastructure and data mapping systems.

• Helping optimise databases, latency, reliability and performance.

• Working closely with a small engineering team of around 3 to 4 people.

• Contributing to systems used across sports, betting, trading and prediction market environments.

• Getting involved in Python, Rust, Docker, AWS, GCP or similar technologies where relevant.

• Supporting scraping, mapping and data-quality workflows.

Who are we looking for?

We are open to different levels, from technically strong interns and early-career engineers through to more experienced backend developers.

The most important thing is that you can show genuine technical depth and real evidence of what you have built.

You will be a strong fit if you have:

• Experience or strong project work with Node.js, TypeScript and SQL.

• A backend-first mindset.

• A live GitHub profile showing recent commits or real shipped projects.

• Experience with APIs and modern backend frameworks.

• Good understanding of software fundamentals and system design basics.

• Interest in real-time systems, sports data, odds, trading, betting, finance or market-making.

• A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset.

• Ability to work well in a small, fast-paced team.

• Lisbon-based location, or a genuine willingness to relocate.

• EU work eligibility.

• Comfort working around 4 days per week on-site in Lisbon.

Nice to have, but not essential

• Python.

• Rust.

• Docker.

• AWS, GCP or similar cloud infrastructure.

• PostgreSQL.

• React or Supabase.

• WebSockets, streaming or high-throughput systems.

• Trading, market-making, betting, odds or sports data experience.

• Open-source contributions or side projects.

• Experience optimising systems for latency and performance.

• Scraping, mapping or data engineering experience.

Priority Crypto

We specialise in emerging tech recruitment, including Web3, blockchain, crypto, AI, fintech and more. We break down barriers and facilitate borderless connections, creating a global network where collaboration drives success. Based in the UK, we operate globally.

Take charge of your journey.

Please follow me on LinkedIn for updates and the latest opportunities across emerging tech, Web3, AI, fintech and crypto.

Due to the anticipated response, we will only be reaching out with screening questions to candidates whose experience appears closely aligned with these opportunities.

Ready to apply? Go for it. We’ll be in touch shortly and we can’t wait to hear what you’ve been building.

title: Internal Engineering Internship – Quality
description:
Quality is at the center of everything we do. We are looking for a rigorous, proactive Engineering Intern with a vision for improvement to join our Quality Department at the Albergaria-a-Velha plant.

If you want to make a real impact, digitize processes, and ensure the compliance and excellence of our daily operations, this internship is for you. You will have the opportunity to work directly on the shop floor, cross-reference data with operational practices, and interact with different teams across the plant.

What you will do (Responsibilities):• Process Mapping: Survey and map current processes, identifying flows and opportunities for improvement and standardization.
• Data Analysis: Collect, process, and analyze operational and quality data from the plant, transforming it into actionable information for decision-making.
• Documentation Management: Review, update, and optimize internal procedures and work instructions, ensuring that Quality standards are always up-to-date and clear to everyone.
• Digitalization and Development (AppSheets): Develop agile applications (AppSheets within our Google environment) to manage and optimize the MMR (Material Management Review / Non-Conforming Materials) process, making it faster, more intuitive, and paperless.
• Cross-functional Coordination: Coordinate Quality activities and action plans in collaboration with various plant departments (Production, Continuous Improvement, Engineering, Maintenance).
• Training: Support the preparation and facilitation of training sessions on Quality standards, tools, and culture for operational teams.

Your profile (Requirements):• Higher Education (Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, Materials Engineering (or related fields).
• Rigor, attention to detail, and strong analytical skills to interpret industrial data.
• Affinity for technology and process digitalization (our daily work is done within the Google ecosystem, and you must be comfortable with or very willing to learn how to create AppSheets).
• Good communication skills, empathy, and ease in interacting with different operational and management levels.
• Dynamic, organized profile with the initiative to propose new solutions and improvements.
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written).

What we offer:• Paid Internship (12-month duration).
• Integration into a reference plant belonging to a leading multinational company in its sector.
• Support and Mentorship: You will have the continuous support of experienced professionals who will guide your technical and personal development.
• Access to the company canteen and other benefits available at our facility.
• A practical, collaborative work environment open to new ideas.

title: Risk Management Trainee
description:
About The Job

• The Risk Management Trainee main mission is to develop solutions for the management of ­financial resources, namely capital, balance sheet, liquidity and risks in general, such as counterparty risk, credit risk, market risk, operational risk and equity risk. In addition, must be aware of future regulatory changes and understand the impacts of it in the business. The focus is on analyzing impacts of the new Basel IV Counterparty framework. Finally, one core mandate is to ensure Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Large Language Model (LLM) is well integrated in business-as-usual (BaU) activities of the team, seeking operational efficiencies and more in-depth analysis

Your Main Activities Are

• To Produce and monitor reports for Balance Sheet metrics, such as Leverage exposure and Global Systemically Important Bank (GSIB)

• You will search for new suppliers in various regions and improve internal processes for team benefit

• You will develop expertise in our suppliers, cost drivers, and sourcing markets/trends to ensure competitive pricing

• You are studying a bachelor's or master's degree in Business, Engineering or related fields

• You are looking for an internship and are available for at least 6 months

• You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment

• You are analytical, well organized, independent, and driven to challenge the status quo, your vendors, and stakeholders. You are ambitious, solution oriented, able to propose unique and creative solutions

• You can communicate well in English and enjoy collaborating with different teams in a multicultural environment

• You are digitally savvy and master MS Office, in particular Excel

• Ideally, you have already gained practical experience in procurement, planning, or supply chain management

 

What we can bring you : 

• A competitive Package of 1250€ monthly ( including meal allowance and Coverflex benefits)

• Private health insurance including dental care

• In-house Portuguese classes from beginner to advanced level

• A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals

• The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects either independently or as part of a dedicated, international team

• Responsibility and decision-making authority from day one—you'll create an impact with new, innovative ideas and help shape our company DNA

• To work and learn from experts in diverse fields and get to know your team members at exciting company events

Become an Emmie

Emma is transforming the world of sleep - and we want the highest-performing people to help us pull it off. We want you. But only if you're willing to go all in. Only if you're willing to question, disrupt, innovate, and create from the ground up. ​

We proudly celebrate diversity. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting inclusion in our workplace. title: Internship Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Internship Programme

Our Internship Programme is designed for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8–10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, tackle meaningful challenges, and develop your skills alongside industry experts. It’s an opportunity to learn, innovate, and build a solid foundation for your career.

Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for Data Scientist and Analyst Interns who believe no data task is too complex. You’ll dig into databases, uncover root causes, design smart solutions, and write the code to bring them to life.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates

• Applications: open from May 2026
• Recruitment process: July–December 2026
• Programme start: June / July 2027

Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.

What You'll Be Doing

• Taking part in a hands-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
• Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
• Improving visibility in user sign-up flows and operational funnels
• Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
• Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights
• Supporting decision-making with ad-hoc analysis (e.g., interest rate sensitivity, incentive profitability, conversion rates)
• Learning from industry leaders and staying aligned with team priorities through weekly meetings
• Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
• Sharing updates with our global teams
• Receiving regular feedback to guide your development

What You'll Need

• To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar field (graduating in 2028)
• Impressive Python and SQL skills
• An interest or experience in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
• A solid foundation in maths and statistics
• A proactive, results-driven mindset
• Fluency in English
• Great communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills
• To be comfortable working in a fast-paced, diverse team environment
• Full-time availability for summer 2027
• The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

•  Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
•  Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

• Analyse and summarise the counterparty and credit risk on clients and prospects
• Prepare Credit Proposals 
• Complete Credit Proposals compliant with guidelines, quality standards and policies
• Participate in the continuous improvement of credit process efficiency
• Monitor Credit Risk
• Ensure the follow-up of client exposure and monitor global credit risks by alerting on any change in ratings, any major event or material evolution
• Monitor client’s covenants, strategy implementation and risk profile 
• Maintain portfolio reports and use proactively the internal credit tools

Profile And Skills To Success

• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or any related fields
• Fluency in English
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel
• Attention to detail and an analytical approach
• Ability to collaborate with others 

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

title: Internship Programme 2027: Product Designer
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Internship Programme

Our Internship Programme is designed for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8–10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, tackle meaningful challenges, and develop your skills alongside industry experts. It’s an opportunity to learn, innovate, and build a solid foundation for your career.

Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Design at Revolut is all about balancing that sense of creativity with a deep attention to detail. Our customers have come to expect a certain level of look and feel from our products, and it's up to us to keep pushing their expectations higher.

We’re looking for Product Design Interns who want to create user-centred experiences, solve design challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver products that customers love.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates

• Applications: open from May 2026
• Recruitment process: July–December 2026
• Programme start: June / July 2027

Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.

What You'll Be Doing

• Designing user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that address customer needs
• Supporting research activities, such as user interviews, usability testing, and surveys
• Applying insights to iterate on designs and improve user experience
• Collaborating with Product Owners, Engineers, and Researchers to ship impactful features
• Presenting findings and design proposals to stakeholders
• Managing project tasks, tracking progress, and sharing updates with global teams
• Receiving feedback and guidance through regular reviews to support your development

What You'll Need

• To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in design or a related field, graduating in 2028
• A predicted first-class degree (or equivalent grade)
• Solid problem-solving and analytical skills
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• A passion for design, innovation, and creating customer-first experiences
• To be comfortable working in a fast-paced, diverse team environment
• Fluency in English
• Full-time availability for summer 2027
• The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)

Nice to have

• Fluency in other languages
• Experience as an entrepreneur or working in a startup

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

•  Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
•  Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: HR Communication Trainee
description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities

•  Internal level: engagement of employees. Working aspects such as work-life balance, internal events and benefits for all employees. Redefine employee lifetime within the company and build new employee’s experience.
•  External level: talent acquisition. Focused on scholars, junior profiles, professionals, and managers

•  Communication: Internal - External (Newsletter, social media)

Your profile and competencies to succeed

• International mindset;
• Good analytical skills;
• Good presentation skills;
• Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing / Good listener;
• Ability to work well with a wide range of people from different parts of the business;
• Ability to manage different projects at the same time;
• Ability to work well under pressure;
• Energetic, enthusiastic and passionate;
• Organized and methodical;
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation;
• Creativity, open mind and autonomy. 

Languages

• English required;
• Spanish (nice to have);

Software

• Canva
• Adobe Creative Cloud: Illustrator, Indesign and Photoshop
• Adobe Premiere / Video editing
• Social media management software: Hootsuite / Buffer / Sprout Social
• Instagram Insights
• Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel)

What We Can Do For You

• At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies. 
• We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development. 
• We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count. 
• We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world) 
• We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans. 
• Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy. 

Why join us

FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.

title: Data Analyst

description:
Who are we?

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

Role Overview

The Junior SDR plays a foundational role in fueling top‑of‑funnel growth for the mid‑market segment. This role focuses primarily on generating and qualifying Net New Name pipeline through early‑stage prospecting activities, supporting inbound lead flow — especially digital campaign and field marketing - and outbound efforts when needed.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their sales career who is eager to learn, grow, and build strong prospecting fundamentals within a high‑performing GTM team.

Key Responsibilities

Top‑of‑Funnel Pipeline Generation (Primary Focus)

• Support mid‑market Net New Name pipeline growth through early‑stage prospecting and qualification.
• Conduct initial outreach via email, phone, social, and other channels to engage potential prospects.
• Adhere to Inbound process KPIs and SLAs.
• Consistently report to Marketing and Sales on Marketing Qualified Leads progression.
• Research accounts and contacts to identify fit, interest, and potential buying triggers.
• Maintain consistent activity levels and contribute to meeting‑setting goals for the mid‑market segment.
• Partner with Sales Executives to drive pipeline activities for the assigned region.

Qualifications

• 0–1 years of SDR, BDR, or customer‑facing experience (internships welcome).
• Native-level English proficiency.
• Strong communication skills — clear, professional, and confident.
• Curiosity, coachability, and a willingness to learn fast.
• Comfortable working in a metrics‑driven environment.
• Basic understanding of sales processes, CRM tools, or marketing funnels is a plus.
• Positive attitude, resilience, and a team‑first mindset.

Benefits

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Well‑being: Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

Health & Financial Security: Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.*

Sustainability: Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

Inclusion: Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

Recognition: Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

• Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: Junior Cloud Pre Sales (Azure)

description:
About Legends Global

Legends Global is redefining excellence in sport, entertainment and live events. With unrivalled expertise and international reach, we provide end-to-end solutions – from venue development and event programming to revenue strategy and hospitality.

We take a 360-degree, data-driven approach across Partnerships, Hospitality, Merchandise and Attractions, working with leading clients to deliver outstanding experiences that resonate worldwide.

Our organisation is committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where diversity drives innovation and collaboration. Guided by our values of Align, Scale, Connect, Team and Win... we create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

FC PORTO

Established in 1893, FC Porto has not stopped growing since. Their DNA is filled with football´s greatest moments and sport milestones.

FC Porto, with more than 80 trophies in their hands, was Portugal Cup’s winner in 2022/2023. Therefore, and to that purpose, they continue fostering excellence as their Estádio do Dragão turns 20 years old.

LEGENDS’ KEY PARTNERSHIP WITH FC PORTO

FC Porto And Legends Have Recently Announced a Multi-channel Partnership. Moreover, Legends Will Provide Their Expertise Through The 360-degree Platform To Drive Growth And Further Strengthen The FC Porto Brand Globally. Through This Partnership Legends Is Supporting FC Porto In Developing Revolutionary Business Model That Consists Of

•  Transforming the fan experience supporting global partnerships as the Food and Beverage experience at Estádio do Dragão, namely in FC Porto Partner’s Club VIP boxes and seats.
•  Collaborate with FC Porto to explore opportunities to improve the overall fan experience at the stadium and enhance commercial opportunities.

About The Role

We are looking to recruit a Junior Accountant to support the Finance function and work closely with the Finance Manager, FC Porto in the day-to-day financial management of the business.

This role will provide operational and analytical support across accounting, reconciliations, reporting and financial control, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of financial information.

The position is intended for a candidate with a solid accounting foundation who is looking to develop within a growing and dynamic business environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Support day-to-day accounting activities, including invoice processing and financial documentation review.
•  Perform bank and balance sheet reconciliations.
•  Assist with monthly and year-end closing processes.
•  Support preparation of financial reports and internal management information.
•  Assist in VAT preparation and other statutory reporting requirements.
•  Monitor supplier accounts and support accounts payable processes.
•  Work with external accountants to ensure accuracy of financial records.
•  Maintain organized financial documentation and ensure compliance with internal controls.
•  Provide ad-hoc support on budgeting, cost analysis and financial projects.

Qualifications And Experience

•  Degree in Accounting, Finance, Management or a related field.
•  1–3 years of experience in accounting, finance or audit roles.
•  Good understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
•  Experience working with accounting systems and Excel.
•  Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
•  Ability to work independently and manage priorities.

Desirable

•  Experience working with external accounting firms or shared finance structures.
•  Familiarity with VAT processes and financial reporting requirements in Portugal.
•  Comfortable working in a fast-paced and operational environment.
•  English Speaking.

description:

• You're comfortable with: Ambiguity, talking to different people, and piecing together information from multiple sources

Key Program Facts:

• Program Length: 6 months
• Location: Lagoas Park, Oeiras. Lisbon, Portugal.
• Working Model: On-site.
• Full-Time

title: Junior Accountant - Remote (Startup & AI-Augmented)
description:
Job title: Junior Accountant (Startup & AI-Augmented)

Location: Remote, Portugal

Type: Internship (IEFP +Talento) with direct conversion to work contract

Experience Level: Entry Level / Recent Graduate

Your accounting degree is not becoming obsolete. It is becoming more powerful.

At BRIDGE IN, the people handling compliance for international companies expanding into Portugal, Spain, and Italy still work with spreadsheets. We are not going to pretend otherwise. What is different is that we are actively replacing the repetitive, soul-crushing parts of that work with automation and AI agents, and you will be part of building that transition. The goal is for the team to spend more time on judgment, analysis, and stakeholder trust, and less time on things a script can do. We are not there yet. But we are moving fast, and joining now means you shape how it gets done.

This is a real internship with a real ending: complete the 6 months successfully, and you move into a full-time work contract. No vague promises.

Why BRIDGE IN?

🌍 We are a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first company on a clear mission: make international bureaucracy disappear. We have helped companies from 35+ countries land and operate in Southern Europe, attracted over €120M in Foreign Direct Investment to Portugal, and have been recognized as one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. We are not backed by VC money chasing a quick exit. We build things that last.

This role sits at the core of what we sell. The accounting function is not a support function here. It is the product.

What You'll Be Doing

• Maintain daily accounting records for BRIDGE IN and a portfolio of international customers, working with multi-country regulatory frameworks from day one 
• Prepare and submit VAT returns and year-end corporate tax filings, including direct communication with the Portuguese Tax Authority (AT) 
• Own month-end closing and reporting for consolidation in multinational structures 
• Dig into trends, spot inconsistencies, and present findings clearly to internal teams and customers. Not just flag problems, but bring a point of view 
• Support customers with accounting and tax queries, handling sensitive financial information with full confidentiality and professionalism 
• Use BRIDGE IN's AI agents and automation tools to eliminate repetitive, low-value tasks so your time goes toward work that actually requires your expertise 

What You Bring to the Table

• A degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a closely related field 
• Full professional fluency in both Portuguese and English 
• Active OCC certification or active willingness to pursue it 
• You are detail-oriented without being paralyzed by imperfection, you can close the books and move 
• You are genuinely curious about how technology changes compliance work, not threatened by it 
• You take ownership. If something is off, you find it, flag it, and propose a fix 

What We Offer💡

• A direct path to a full-time work contract after 6 months. This is the intention, not a maybe 
• Compensation aligned with the IEFP +Talento program grant structure 
• A remote-first environment where output matters and nobody is counting your keystrokes 
• Exposure to international business that you simply cannot get in a traditional firm at the entry-level 
• Access to AI tools and agents that make your work faster and your learning curve steeper in the best possible way 
• A team promoted entirely on merit and output, where your growth is directly tied to what you deliver 

What Happens Next

We don't do corporate black holes. This is a real, open role, and not a ghost job to harvest resumes. Here is the general roadmap: start with a quick application form. If we're aligned, we'll send over a self-evaluation survey, followed by human-to-human interviews and a hands-on challenge so you can show, not just tell, what you can do. We're a startup, so the exact steps might iterate, but we guarantee three things: we (try to) move fast, we are radically transparent, and we will never waste your time.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

The Sales Engineer will act as a strategic technical advisor supporting complex, multi-country sales engagements across Sovos’ tax and compliance technology portfolio.

This is a junior pre-sales role for a commercially driven professionals who thrives in enterprise environments, leads structured discovery, and confidently positions high-value solutions. While deep tax expertise is not required, the ability to quickly understand regulatory frameworks and articulate business impact is essential.

You will operate independently, partnering closely with Sales, Alliances, Product and Professional Services to drive revenue growth in both direct and partner-led opportunities

More Specifically You Will

• Lead complex, multi-entity discovery sessions across global customer organisations
• Map customer transaction flows, ERP landscapes, and regulatory exposure
• Design scalable, cross-border solution architectures aligned to business and compliance needs
• Confidently position the commercial value of Sovos solutions, not just demonstrate functionality
• Influence technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision-makers
• Partner with Sales to shape account strategy and advance deals through structured qualification
• Own technical responses for enterprise RFPs, RFIs and global tenders
• Deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting global regulatory and ERP scenarios
• Operate as a trusted advisor in partner-led and embedded solution models
• Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless transition from pre-sales to implementation
• Contribute to global pre-sales best practices, messaging, and competitive positioning
• Maintain high-quality demo environments aligned with global market requirements

What We Need From You

• 1+ years of experience in Sales Engineering or Technical Pre-Sales within enterprise software
• Proven success supporting complex, multi-country or enterprise-level deals
• Strong ability to lead structured discovery and solution mapping conversations
• Commercial mindset with confidence influencing customer buying decisions
• Experience navigating ERP ecosystems is highly desirable
• Exposure to tax, compliance, regulatory, finance or adjacent domains is advantageous
• Comfortable operating independently with limited regional infrastructure
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French
• Ability to work effectively across time zones and global teams
• Willingness to travel occasionally

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

• An opportunity to work with a global team
• Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
• Mentoring Programs
• Globally recognised Training and Development programs
• Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter .

title: Junior School PE Teacher
description:
Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

ROLE SUMMARY:

PaRK International School, located in Lisbon, is a leading international school committed to academic excellence and the holistic development of every student. With a multicultural community of students representing more than 60 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, safe, and inspiring environment. We believe that the success of our students is closely linked to the personal and professional growth of our staff, and we actively promote collaboration, continuous training, and meaningful participation in school life.

To join our team, we are looking for a dedicated and highly organised Junior School Physical Education Teacher, with a strong commitment to promoting physical well-being and contributing to the vibrant sporting life of our learning community. The ideal candidate will demonstrate professionalism, a focus on student safety, excellent communication skills, and a genuine interest in inspiring young learners to develop a lifelong love for physical activity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Plan and deliver high-quality PE lessons focused on sport-specific skills, tactics, and progression across the KS2 curriculum. 
• Cultivate an inclusive, active environment that challenges students and promotes lifelong healthy habits. 
• Assess and track progress, providing feedback that encourages student self-evaluation and technical growth. 
• Foster leadership and resilience through competitive sport, teamwork, and fair play. 
• Lead extracurricular clubs and inter-school fixtures, coordinating tournaments and sporting events. 
• Engage with parents and staff to report on student achievement and support whole-school wellbeing initiatives. 
• Contribute to pastoral care, using sport to model positive behavior and build student confidence. 

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

• Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) with proven experience delivering PE in a Junior School/KS2 setting. 
• Strong pedagogical knowledge of sport-specific skills, tactical gameplay, and adolescent physical development. 
• Excellent English communication skills, capable of engaging students, parents, and coaching staff. 
• Passion for inclusive excellence, balancing "sport for all" with the development of competitive school teams. 
• Proactive team player committed to leading extracurricular clubs, fixtures, and whole-school events. 

SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT:

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

title: Secondary Valuation Analyst Trainee
description:
#CapitalMarkets #EquityDerivatives #Flow #StructuredProducts #InstitutionalClients #SecondaryMarkets

About The Job

• The Valuation Analyst position in Lisbon focuses on dealing with daily valuations which are not only a crucial element for our clients and for the bank’s risk management (via collateral) but are also the basis for prices on secondary trades
• The Valuation Analyst role isn’t about pricing clients’ requests for quote (RFQ), however, it involves a type of ad-hoc decision-making that directly impacts BNP Paribas’ (BNPP) PNL, while also demanding synthesis and optimization capabilities

Your Main Activities Are

• Provide clients with high-quality, accurate valuations
• Take ownership of the valuation chain including its impact on secondary trades
• Address requests pertaining to valuations, from client service, sales or collateral management
• Conduct deep-dives into specific valuations to provide performance analysis
• Participate in the development and scalability of the platform to improve client satisfaction, by enhancing the quality, speed and accuracy of valuations

Profile And Skills To Success

• Master Degree in Finance or Similar
• Fluent in English
• Client‑focused mindset
• Ability to effectively deliver projects
• Sound decision‑making skills under pressure
• Risk‑aware approach to daily tasks
• Solid knowledge of equity derivatives and structured products
• Ability to write code and understand system architecture and interdependencies

About The Team

• Within Global Equities & Commodity Derivatives department, SCOPE Trading (Secondary Client Offer & Post Trade) is a global team in charge of providing a market on secondary trades on exotic products and facilitating various aspects of BNPP’s secondary market, in particular providing our clients with the most accurate daily valuations on the entire range of products (flow and exotics) traded with them, as well as supporting them with performance explanations on their trades
• SCOPE occupies a unique and strategic position dealing with the entire gamut of products BNPP’s EQD department has to offer, with constant interactions with Sales and Traders
• Global Markets, the capital markets division of BNP Paribas' Corporate & Institutional Banking, is a powerhouse delivering top-tier solutions across asset classes. Our Portugal Platform (Porto and Lisbon) stands as a major European HUB and a unique player in the country, boasting a wide range of Front Office roles and services – Trading, Sales, Research, Structuring, Quants & Engineering, Business Dev and Support, Marketing & Client Support, Risk Management, Data Analytics and Machine Learning. With rapid growth and ambitions to make a global impact, we offer numerous short and long-term opportunities

Get a glimpse into our world- Check out our Global Markets Portugal webpage

Why joining BNP Paribas? 

• Leading banking institution

Leading player in banking and financial services in Europe, BNP Paribas operates in 64 countries and has nearly 178,000 employees, including more than 144,000 in Europe

• International reach 

The Group holds key positions in several areas of banking and financial services that are structured around three operating divisions:

• Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) connects companies needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities division that offers tailored financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients.
• Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS) brings together all our commercial banks and several specialised businesses
• Investment & Protection Services (IPS) combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real estate including specialised businesses offering a wide range of savings, investment and protection services
• Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.220 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 centres of expertise providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

• Diversity and Inclusion commitment 

BNP Paribas ´ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility – Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

• Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees
• Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

• Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

• Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

description:
Job Title: Accounting Associate, AI-Enabled Practice

Location: Remote, Portugal

Type: Full-Time Internship (with direct conversion to work contract)

Experience Level: Junior

You recently graduated in accounting, and the headlines are probably telling you that artificial intelligence is coming for your job. We completely disagree. At BRIDGE IN, we believe in a powerful binomial relationship between human expertise and advanced technology. Your degree is incredibly valuable. We will pair your foundational knowledge with intelligent agents and automation to eliminate repetitive data entry. Your biggest impact over your first six months will be helping us transition to an increasingly technology-driven accounting delivery model. You will get your hands dirty with real numbers, skip the basic administrative grind, and learn how to do actual financial analysis much faster than you would in a traditional corporate firm.

Why BRIDGE IN? 🌍

We exist to eliminate the burden of bureaucracy for companies expanding into Southern Europe. By leveraging technology and operational excellence, we empower global organizations to build distributed teams without the administrative friction. We have helped companies from 35+ countries land and operate in Southern Europe, attracted over €120M in Foreign Direct Investment to Portugal, and have been recognized as one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

You will be stepping into a fast-moving, profitable startup environment where high agency is expected and rewarded. We care about intense focus and concrete outcomes rather than arbitrary office hours or artificial stress.

What You Will Be Building 🚀

• Maintain daily accounting records for both BRIDGE IN and our international customers 
• Prepare monthly reporting for consolidation across multinational entities alongside VAT and annual corporate tax filings 
• Analyze financial trends and inconsistencies to present clear findings to the team 
• Collaborate directly with Tax Authorities to ensure compliance and resolve inquiries 
• Assist with financial forecasts to identify growth areas and support customer queries relating to accounting and taxes 
• Ensure complete compliance with local accounting standards while maintaining stakeholder trust and strict confidentiality 

What You Bring to the Table 💡

• You must be eligible for the IEFP +Talento program in Portugal (you are a recent graduate or currently registered as unemployed) 
• You hold a degree in accounting or finance and are ready to apply that knowledge in a high-velocity learning environment 
• You have an active OCC certification or are eager and willing to apply for one 
• You speak and write with full professional fluency in both Portuguese and English 
• You view artificial intelligence as a powerful accelerator to make your daily work easier, rather than a threat to your career 
• You possess a high degree of agency and thrive in a remote setting where you are trusted to manage your own focus 
• You communicate clearly and can translate complex financial regulations into straightforward insights for customers 

What We Offer

• A direct path to a full-time work contract after a successful 6-month internship. This is the intention, not a maybe 
• A fully remote setup within Portugal, giving you the freedom to design your optimal work environment 
• A steep learning curve where you will own actual projects and touch every part of the accounting cycle 
• Exposure to modern tech stacks and AI agents that will dramatically accelerate your professional development 
• A culture of radical transparency and peer collaboration without toxic corporate politics 
• Stability inside a bootstrapped and profitable company that values sustainable growth over venture capital hype 

How to Apply

We don’t do corporate black holes. This is a real open role and not a ghost job to harvest resumes. Here is the general roadmap: start with a quick application form. If we are aligned, we will send over a self-evaluation survey followed by direct human interviews and a hands-on challenge so you can show, not just tell, what you can do. We’re a startup, so the exact steps might iterate, but we guarantee three things: we try to move fast, we are radically transparent, and we will never waste your time.
